prompt: A ninja dojo: sneak past the guards and ring the bell

intent.setting: A traditional Japanese ninja dojo interior featuring tatami floors, wooden pillars, a central training dais, and a large bronze temple bell suspended from the ceiling in a shadowed rear alcove.
intent.role: A stealthy ninja infiltrator with quiet footstep and shadow-clinging abilities
intent.goal: Sneak through the dojo undetected to physically ring the bronze bell
intent.fail: Being spotted by any of the stationary or patrolling guards, causing an immediate alert and mission failure
intent.headline: Requires strict path-finding through guard patrols to reach the rear bell
